summary: All 43 source files matched their recorded hashes and sizes, and all ten computations reproduced. Across 13,311 paired genes, Pearson was 0.95202240, Spearman was 0.89977248, and 86.54% agreed in direction. Neither concordance route passed. The corrected proposal retains the `compared` closure, clarifies the evidence for the filter and contrast, and distinguishes 13,938 published symbols from 13,948 rows used for FDR adjustment. It passed the repository proposal validator.
openIssues: The paper reports five LP and six LPIP animals. GEO labels and the archived design give six LP and five LPIP. The exact sample assignments used for sheet D remain unconfirmed.
The archived script omits the sheet-D test command. The workbook establishes the reported contrast direction, effects, and statistics.
The registered fit retains SPIP19, which the authors excluded. The comparison cannot isolate the effect of that exclusion from differences in filtering, aggregation, and model fitting.
